Name: Ad Astra - Per Stardew
Author: MagicianFlea
Description:
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/44138/44138-1786134285-1710450402.png[/img][/center]
[center][size=6][b][i]A[/i][/b][/size][font=Arial][size=6][i][b]d Astra Per Stardew[/b][/i][/size][/font][/center]
[center][font=Arial][i][size=3](To the Stars, Via Stardew) [/size][/i][/font][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][font=Arial][size=4]With brand new areas, characters to get to know, and stories to unveil, [i]Ad Astra Per Stardew[/i] is a fan expansion aiming to bring the quiet world of Stardew Valley to the next great frontier: the stars![/size][/font][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][line]
[/center]
[center][/center]
[center][font=Arial][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/44138/44138-1786134285-494285169.png[/img][/font][/center]

[center][size=4][font=Arial]With new maps -- ranging from an outpost in the mountains with a shady past, to a long forgotten island with dangerous weather, all the way to the surface of another planet -- there are over 30 brand new areas to explore![/font][/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=4][font=Arial]Perhaps, in your adventures you'll encounter one of the 3 characters new to the Valley: Juno, a Linguist from the University of Ferngill, in town for clandestine reasons; a mysterious derelict robot, hidden in the depths; or a visitor who may not even be from this world.[/font][/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=4]It all starts after the Quarry has been unlocked, and a peculiar new path makes itself known...[/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][line]
[/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=3][font=Arial][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/44138/44138-1786134288-200832027.png[/img][/font][/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=4]Prepare to come across new crops with new growing conditions and powerful benefits[/size][/center]
[center][size=4](Perhaps some plants don't enjoy quite so much sunlight)[/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=4]New farm animals with strange and downright unnatural origins...[/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=4]New fish, both caught and trapped, with a few mysterious legends hiding among them...[/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=4]New forage...[/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=4]New trees...[/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=4]New recipes...[/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=4]And new, extremely powerful weapons![/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][font=Arial][size=4]On top of that, look forward to several brand new, challenging dungeons filled with monsters never seen before, and treasures a plenty! [/size][/font][/center]
[center][line]
[/center]
[center][/center]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/44138/44138-1786137639-449308964.png[/img][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=4]This mod is still a work [/size][size=4]in progress and I am a solo dev with a life and job that need doing. As such, there are no promises on when this may be fully completed. That said, look forward to some of the following in the future:[/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=4]Expanded dialogue, schedules, and events for all characters[/size][/center]
[center][size=4]A visit to another planet (or several)[/size][/center]
[center][size=4]More crops, trees, forage, fish, and items to collect[/size][/center]
[center][size=4]New machines with special uses[/size][/center]
[center][size=4]New farm animals with unique items[/size][/center]
[center][size=4]New farm buildings[/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=4][u]And maybe some of these:[/u][/size][/center]
[center][size=4]A new farm map type[/size][/center]
[center][size=4]A new festiva[/size][size=4]l?[/size][/center]
[center][size=4]Time Travel??[/size][/center]
[center][size=4]Psionic Abilities???[/size][/center]
[center][size=4]A new Tool????[/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][line]
[/center]
[center][font=Arial][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/44138/44138-1786134281-1428811991.png[/img][/font][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=4]This mod makes use of several frameworks which are required for it to work properly. I originally attempted not to use many, however, I found that there are significantly more features available if they are used. [/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[left][size=4][u][b]Re[/b][/u][/size][size=4][b][u]quired[/u] (Will not work without these):[/b][/size][/left]
[left][/left]
[left][size=4][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/b][/size][/left]
[left][size=4][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url][/b][/size][/left]
[left][size=4][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14493]Mapping Extensions and Extra Properties (MEEP)[/url][/b][/size][/left]
[left][size=4][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27100]Buttons Extra Trigger Action Stuff (BETAS)[/url][/b][/size][/left]
[left][/left]
[left][size=4][u][b]Required [/b][/u][b](May be technically functional without but highly recommended):[/b][/size][/left]
[left][size=4][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23135]Cloudy Skies[/url][/b][/size][/left]
[left][/left]
[left][size=4][u][b]Specific Support For:[/b][/u][/size][/left]
[left][size=4][b]Stardew Valley Expanded[/b][/size][/left]
[left][size=4][b]More Lively Quarry Overhaul[/b][/size][/left]
[left][font=Arial][size=4]
I have tested this mod with over 300 others, however, I cannot guarantee it will not have issues with other mods. Please let me know if you experience any issues with cross mod compatibility. [/size][/font][/left]
[left][line]
[/left]
[left][/left]
[center][b][font=Arial][size=4][u]Final Notes[/u][/size][/font][/b][/center]
[left][/left]
[left][font=Arial][size=4]Many thanks to Hayato2236, who has been a great friend and guide in modding. Go check out his great mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29425]Nando's Farm of Tomorrow![/url][/size][/font][/left]
[left][/left]
[left][font=Arial][size=4]Juno may damage items in the Quarry with her pathing, but there is significantly more usable space from this mod, so hopefully the tradeoff is worth it.[/size][/font][/left]
[left][/left]
[left][font=Arial][size=4]If you are making your own mod and would like to use any of the assets I have created for this mod, you are welcome to do so as long as you give me a credit of some kind. Art should be shared, but not in the crappy AI way, you feel? ;)[/size][/font][/left]

Downloads.Description: A huge expansion to the content from the last update! New areas, new quests, and new items to find.

Manifest.Name: Ad Astra, Per Stardew
Manifest.Description: Something is buried deep in the mountains, a secret which may reveal the past. Or pave the way for the future?
Manifest.Author: MagicianFlea
